messages:
sophie: quick flag  seen a subtle correctness drift when runtime 3.4.0 hits quantized llama3q models under long-prefix batching. thinking temporary runtime pin for hosted `llama3q-quant` while we patch.
sophie: repro shows occasional attention bias at token ~4096 in canary, not catastrophic but reproducible on our eval prompts.
raj: can you drop the log snippet and estimated affected traffic? want to judge blast radius.
sophie: snippet from canary @ 06:22 UTC:
```
W2026-05-02T06:22:11Z runtime[3.4.0] attention.go:278 mismatch: windowed-attn idx out of range
E2026-05-02T06:22:11Z serving: generation error: ErrAttnOverflow
```
Traffic: ~0.6% of hosted traffic hits `llama3q-quant`, long-seq jobs ~5% of that.
lina: is this new kernel selection path in 3.4.0? we added adaptive windowing last week.
raj: yep adaptive-windowing + contiguous-kv interplay. high probability fixable by a minor runtime patch, but ETA ~48h.
claire: propose a scoped runtime pin for hosted model group to avoid customer regressions across the weekend change window.
mike: agree for hosted. Dedicated/Private unaffected unless they opt in; we'll notify SEs.
sophie: suggested deploy-bot command (scoped + expiry):
```
/deploybot pin --component=runtime --version=3.3.8 --scope=hosted --target=model-group:llama3q-quant --expiry=36h --reason="mitigate attn overflow in 3.4.0" --staged=5%
```
deploy-bot: pin request accepted: runtime=3.3.8 target=model-group:llama3q-quant scope:hosted staged:5% -> queued
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled change window 2026-05-02 07:00-09:00 UTC. Pin operations during this window will be rate-limited.
claire: please set explicit rollout steps and rollback criteria in the ops note. I'll create `/release/ops/pins/2026-05-02-runtime-3.3.8-pin.md`.
sophie: rollout plan:
- canary 5% now (us-west pools)
- 30% after 20m if stable
- 80% after 45m if green
- 100% only after 2h with no regressions
rollback triggers: +1.0% absolute 5xx rate, >15ms p95 token latency increase, or any reproducible eval correctness drop >0.5% on reg set
raj: running targeted eval suite and long-prefix test harness now. will post results in 10m.
lina: can we also add a temporary routing rule to prefer runtime 3.3.8 for `longseq:true` requests to reduce exposure if pin can't be fully applied quickly?
sophie: good idea. combine pin + routing fallback. deploy-bot supports a routing override flag?
deploy-bot: routing-override available. sample command:
```
/deploybot route-override --from=runtime:3.4.0 --to=runtime:3.3.8 --predicate="model:llama3q-quant AND meta.longseq=true" --expiry=36h
```
claire: i will include the routing override in ops note and list on-call contacts (sophie, raj, lina) + escalation to runtime team if patch ETA slips beyond 36h.
mike: I'll message SEs and add a customer-facing incident template in case enterprise users surface issues.
raj: canary eval: no correctness regressions so far on 200 runs, 5xx unchanged, p95 +2ms. long-seq harness triggered the attn overflow twice before the pin.
sophie: okay proceed to 30% at +20m. i'll monitor infra/redwood-5xx, infra/redwood-serving-p95 and eval/llama3q-quant/regression.
deploy-bot: applied 5% canary at 2026-05-02T07:05:00Z. monitoring hooks active.
ops-bot: automated alert thresholds set: 5xx increase (1% absolute), p95 +15ms, eval regression 0.5%. Pager triggered on breaches.
lina: runtime team starting hotfix branch now. if patch arrives earlier we can lift the pin and roll forward.
claire: ops note created: /release/ops/pins/2026-05-02-runtime-3.3.8-pin.md includes rollback steps, routing override, and expiry.
raj: no signals after 20m. approve 30% bump.
deploy-bot: scheduling staged rollout -> 30% at 2026-05-02T07:25:00Z.
sophie: thanks. keep this thread for status. i'll close after 100% or rollback. :thumbsup:
